headline: 1.3% of transactions failed in the last 12 minutes; most often SlippageTooHigh on SN36, 4 times

top_errors.title: Slippage too high
top_errors.meaning: A stake, unstake, or move would move the price past the slippage-protection limit (default 5% tolerance)
top_errors.fix: the pool cannot absorb this trade; reduce the amount or split it into smaller steps

top_errors.title: Bad origin
top_errors.meaning: The call was dispatched with the wrong origin: the signing key (or the unsigned/root origin used) is not allowed to make this call
top_errors.fix: sign with the key or origin that owns the target object, then retry

top_errors.title: Registration price limit exceeded
top_errors.meaning: `burned_register` with a price limit failed because the subnet's current registration burn cost exceeds the supplied `limit_price`
top_errors.fix: a chain-side capacity limit was hit; reduce the size or count of the request

top_errors.title: Insufficient liquidity
top_errors.meaning: The pool cannot absorb the operation: the swap simulation failed, reserves are smaller than the payout, or the amount exceeds the pool's supported input
top_errors.fix: the pool cannot absorb this trade; reduce the amount or split it into smaller steps
